notes.title: Don Quixotes of Tomorrow is out now!
notes.notes:
[i]Hear me now, oh, thou bleak and unbearable world
Thou art base and debauched as can be
And a knight with her banners all bravely unfurled
Now hurls down her gauntlet to thee![/i]

Let us tell you one more story of the battles lost and the battles won, against humanity, against dreams, against oneselves. Learn about El Capitan's past, hear Dottore's drunken confessions and find out something about the protagonist's troublesome affections. Play it as a seamless part of the main game or as a standalone story, completely for free!

notes.title: The Soul Box Soundtrack
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of [i]The Soul Box[/i] official soundtrack. Compiled album consists of the tracks from the main game as well as some from the upcoming DLC. Join Nameless Ghoul on this mezmerizing ride through the City.

OST comes as a free bonus for all owners of the main game.

notes.title: Tiny hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a small launch bug. Now you can enjoy the story without waving off a pesky error message!
